data.narrative:
Liminal Insights is a Series A climate and energy technology company founded by Barry Van Tassell and Shaurjo Biswas, having raised $38.9M to date. The valuation framework draws on a comp universe of nine private frontier-tech firms in the Climate & Energy sector (including Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Enovix) alongside one public comparable.

The applicable triangulation method is stage-progression analysis. Using total capital raised ($39M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement, this approach yields an implied valuation of $78M. The peer-median method was not applicable given insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy peer set; while eight same-sector peers exist, fewer than three met the tighter valuation-tier filters necessary to establish a meaningful median benchmark.

The triangulated valuation range is $66M to $89M, with a median of $78M. This range reflects single-method validation and carries material uncertainty stemming from the limited peer overlap in stage and valuation tier. Forward valuation hinges on execution in a sector where comparable firms remain largely pre-profitability; investor conviction will ultimately depend on technology differentiation and path to cash-flow generation rather than public market multiples.
